question: Which Yoginī and associated time-collections are satisfied as having the face of the kula?
premises: The Yoginī is described as kula-faced.
The collections of time are included in the satisfaction.
inference: The practitioner satisfies the kula-faced Yoginī together with the time-collections.
uncertainties: The grammatical coordination between yoginīṅ and kālasandarbbhān is ambiguous.
plain_english: I satisfy the kula-faced Yoginī and the collections of time.
